artifact.basis: JADX static inspection of the shipped APK; it was not executed. This describes app-side protocol schema, not observed XM6 device behavior.

response.parser: count read unsigned; pair i starts at offset 3+2*i; FunctionType.fromByteCode(Table.NO_1, type); NO_USE entries omitted; version converted unsigned.
response.validation: response class checks command bytes and exact count-derived length before parser

functionTypeEnum.inspection: Enum class summary lists function names. fromByteCode(table, byte) iterates values and returns the matching table+byte, otherwise NO_USE. The large <clinit> failed REA disassembly; the selected numeric tuples below were obtained from raw static DEX initializer instructions in the exact artifact.
functionTypeEnum.selectedConstantsBasis: Analyst static decode of constructor tuples in FunctionType.<clinit> from the artifact DEX; no runtime device support was observed.

supportedFunctions.countCaveat: The parser treats count unsigned while the validator expression uses a signed Java byte multiplication. Do not impose the earlier proposed 0..127 range without confirming the exact inherited validator semantics; oversized values are constrained by exact packet length and available array bytes.

getters.capability: request factory appends inquiry byte to the NCASM_GET_CAPABILITY command header; no trailing request parameters evidenced.
getters.status: request factory appends inquiry byte to NCASM_GET_STATUS command header. One evidenced status serializer appends inquiry, ValueChangeStatus, NcAsmOnOffValue in that order after command header; this is only one branch, not a universal status schema.
getters.param: request factory appends inquiry byte to NCASM_GET_PARAM command header; response dispatch is inquiry-specific. The captured dispatcher requires at least two bytes and selects a response parser by inquiry enum ordinal, but only eleven cases are mapped in the captured method; remaining inquiries are not proven supported by that dispatcher.

paramGetInquiry0x17.requestValidator: exactly 2 bytes; request command 0x66; known inquiry required
paramGetInquiry0x17.responseValidator: RET_PARAM header 0x67; exact length 7; inquiry byte 0x17; NcAsmMode and AmbientSoundMode must decode to known values. The level byte is read unsigned and has no range check in this protocol parser.

paramSetInquiry0x17.serializer: NCASM_SET_PARAM builder accepts ValueChangeStatus, NcAsmOnOffValue, NcAsmMode, AmbientSoundMode, int; writes inquiry/status/onOff then mode/ambientMode and (int & 0xff).
paramSetInquiry0x17.validator: outer builder requires command 0x68 plus valid ValueChangeStatus at offset 2 and NcAsmOnOffValue at offset 3; inquiry-specific validator requires exact length 7, inquiry 0x17 and known NcAsmMode/AmbientSoundMode. No semantic level min/max/step validation in the wire parser.
paramSetInquiry0x17.range: No fixed range established. The serializer truncates the int to its low byte (wire encoding 0..255), while the application feature maps slider values using capability-provided ambient range min/max/step. Exact XM6 3.1.5 values require its live capability response/readback; do not assume 0..255 is the device's accepted semantic range.

ncasm.validatorLimits: Captured outer response validators require matching command header and payload length > 1, but type-specific response lengths/field ranges were not captured for every branch. The complete static 0x17 branch is documented above; other inquiries remain incomplete.
ncasm.set: One NCASM_SET_PARAM inquiry 0x17 serializer and validator branch is established as above; another status-shaped setter branch exists. Do not send until the actual device advertises this capability and a live XM6 3.1.5 baseline/readback establishes current values, permitted ambient level range, and a reversible restore path. ACK/response behavior alone does not establish application.

capabilityGet.validator: matching table/command superclass validation, exactly 2 bytes, inquiry decode must not be OUT_OF_RANGE

paramGet.validator: matching table/command superclass validation, exactly 2 bytes, inquiry decode must not be OUT_OF_RANGE

getters.responseDispatch: Capability response dispatcher uses inquiry enum. PRESET_EQ and EBB map to the generic capability response class; other inquiry branches in this dispatcher map to another class. The full branch/return value schema and device-specific bounds are still not established. Parameter getter responses and application-facing band value parsing remain under investigation.

statusGet.validator: matching table/command superclass validation, exactly 2 bytes, inquiry decode must not be OUT_OF_RANGE

getters.statusResponse: An object parser class exists, but its complete byte-field layout and response (0x53) validator have not been established. Do not treat the request parser's validator as response validation.

eqebb.set: EQEBB_SET_PARAM command ID exists, but the serializer for a particular inquiry is not enough to establish safe accepted ranges. Do not send. No band count, frequency grid or gain range is claimed.

eq.status: Static GET_CAPABILITY and GET_PARAM factories/validators plus the inquiry enum are now identified under eqebb. Status GET and complete returned-value layouts remain unresolved. No EQ band count, frequency grid, dB range, gain step, or device support claim is stated.
eq.set: EQEBB_SET_PARAM command ID exists, but a verified serializer plus full inquiry-specific accepted ranges and safe baseline are not established. Do not send.
eq.evidenceGap: Response branch classes and their complete validators/field semantics remain to be inspected; for model support require a runtime capability response from the actual device.

supportBoundary: Static schema evidence documents what the companion APK can encode and parse. It does not prove the headset advertises a feature, accepts a request, or applies a setting. The separately hardware-verified model/firmware/battery observations in v2-readout-spec.json do not extend to controls.
